title: SpaceNews | Parsons Lands $85 Million Deal To Oversee Design And Construction Of Space Command HQ
summary: WASHINGTON — The Pentagon awarded Parsons an $85 million agreement to help manage the development and construction of U.S. Space Command’s new headquarters in Alabama.
